custom/studentdaily.exec: if command -v studentdaily >/dev/null 2>&1; then studentdaily status --waybar; else "$HOME/.local/bin/classes" status --waybar; fi
custom/studentdaily.on-click: if command -v studentdaily >/dev/null 2>&1; then studentdaily pin; else "$HOME/.local/bin/classes" pin; fi
custom/studentdaily.on-click-right: if command -v studentdaily >/dev/null 2>&1; then studentdaily reload; else "$HOME/.local/bin/classes" reload; fi
